Fictional events, stylized architecture, safe vector SVG characters, no gore, suspenseful warm-to-cold lighting, visual motion synced to dialogue, no image watermarks. Improved depth staging: full-bleed school worlds, scale-correct rig cast, clean layering, no rotating doors or oversized floating background.

rules.text: นิยายแต่ง: โรงเรียนมีอยู่จริง แต่เหตุการณ์ซอมบี้ทั้งหมดไม่ใช่เรื่องจริง
Scene voiceover has exactly one assigned Thai voice profile. Audio files are not embedded; generate TTS and verify exact audio durations before export.
Do not replace event props with generic buildings; retain props placement and keyframes and do not generate gore.
Authored door motion per scene is in productionMotionOverrides: closing in scene 5, locked in scenes 6/9 and opening in scenes 10/12. No accidental opening during a locked-door beat.
All fictional-school locations use StorySchoolWorld full-screen vector backgrounds and no duplicated environment customAsset overlays. Doors interpolate physical opening width.
Character running uses authored motionKeys with actual travel time and ending stand pose. Zombie at finale appears only once the rooftop door begins opening.
